messages:
Anya: Quick copy ops hourglass — can someone sweep the beta blog (hero, 3 claims, CTA + webinar registration path) before EOD? We need to lock CTAs for HubSpot and add bench numbers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samir: I can take hero + claims. Will post PR to Google doc in ~30m.
Nina: I'll own the webinar invite matrix + registration mapping. @Devon can you confirm demo capacity for 2pm/4pm slots?
Devon: 2pm/4pm both ok today; leaning 2pm if we expect higher traffic. I'll update Calendly and HubSpot form after Samir's copy is final.
Blake: Heads up — legal will want a quick pass on any absolute language ("guarantee", etc). @Mira (Legal) can you triage?
Mira (Legal): On it. I can review by 4pm. If you keep the language as "up to" or "typically", we should be fine.
Samir: Drafts uploaded: https://docs.google.com/xxx - hero options A/B/C and 3 claim variants. Short TL;DR in the doc: tightened claim + qualifier, removed superlatives.
Nina: HubSpot mapping snippet for registration (putting here for visibility):
```
utm_source=product_email
utm_campaign=beta_launch
hubspot_field: demo_slot (values: 14:00, 16:00)
form_action: /forms/demo-beta
```
Devon: Also adding lead-routing rule: if utm_campaign=beta_launch -> assign owner queue = "beta-demo"; high priority if company_size > 100.
Anya: Perfect. @Samir @Nina drop final copy & mapping in this thread when done; I'll do a final sanity pass and confirm publish window.
Samir: Final copy posted at 12:18pm in doc (short hero chosen = option B). Leaving one alt headline.
Mira (Legal): Quick note: approved language for latency claim = "up to 3x faster in our benchmarks". Remove any instance of "always" or "guaranteed".
Nina: Registration paths set, Calendly 2pm slot pinned for webinar demo, HubSpot form updated and test submission successful.
Anya: Great — locking CTAs. Proposed publish window = tomorrow 3pm PST. If no flags by 4pm today, I'll schedule the publish. :rocket:
